name: Azora
rationale: Spanish asset manager; equity investor in Volta Infra AND arranger of a separate ~$5bn multi-bank financing program to fund AI 'factories' (2026-08-04). Structuring debt for GPU compute alongside NVIDIA - an infra-credit allocator worth tracking.

name: Michael Dell
rationale: Participated personally (not Dell Technologies) in Volta Infra's $300m round at a $2.4bn valuation, 2026-08-04. Founder-investor deploying personal capital into neocloud/GPU infrastructure.

name: XTX Ventures
rationale: Co-led Proxima Fusion's EUR 411m Series A2 (2026-07-07) alongside Alphabet/Google. Venture arm of quant firm XTX Markets; leading, not just following, in fusion.

name: East X Ventures
rationale: Co-led Proxima Fusion's EUR 411m Series A2 (2026-07-07) alongside Alphabet/Google. European deep-tech lead investor in the largest European fusion round on record.

name: RWE
rationale: German utility taking a strategic EQUITY stake in Proxima Fusion (2026-07-07), months after an agreement to co-build a stellarator plant at the former Gundremmingen fission site. A European corporate allocator on the energy_for_ai theme.

name: NAVER
rationale: Korea's largest internet company. Not only the target of NVIDIA's $1bn stake - NAVER is explicitly 'funding the remaining amounts' of the ~$10bn+ GAK Sejong AI factory buildout and is scaling toward 1GW. A sovereign-AI corporate allocator in its own right.

name: Bitdeer Technologies
rationale: Nasdaq-listed bitcoin-miner-turned-DC-operator supplying the 133MW Norway site behind Volta's ~$10bn compute contract, with Texas and Wyoming expansion planned. Capital-deploying DC owner in the NVIDIA orbit.

name: Burda Principal Investments
rationale: Participated in Proxima Fusion's Series A2 (2026-07-07). German corporate-backed growth investor appearing on energy_for_ai deals.

name: KfW Capital
rationale: German state development-bank investment arm; participated in Proxima Fusion's Series A2 (2026-07-07). State capital co-investing with a US hyperscaler on European fusion - a sovereign_ai/energy_for_ai signal.

name: SPRIND
rationale: German Federal Agency for Disruptive Innovation; participated in Proxima Fusion's Series A2 (2026-07-07). Government agency deploying direct equity alongside Alphabet.
